title: 第21章 长生无敌一道身影就可镇压万古第22章 魂灯熄灭魏族族长带人前往道一圣地
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
天地昏暗，狂风暴雨肆虐大地。
恐怖雷霆如若狰狞的蜈蚣，在昏暗的天穹中轰轰作响，像是宣布死亡的降临。
天帝力量笼罩道一圣地。
带着不可抵挡之势，落了下来！
“啊…不要！”
“呜呜呜…我不想死啊！”
“谁来救救我们？”
哭声响彻道一圣地。
所有的道一圣地成员，全都在绝望的哭泣。
在天帝力量面前。
他们太过渺小了，渺小若尘埃，完全无力抵挡。
“蝼蚁。”
高空之上，中年男人冷漠的注视这一切，发出不屑的笑声。
“这里的蝼蚁要死光了！”
男童也在笑，毫无怜悯之心。
他乐于见到血流成河的场景。
甚至——
他曾经还亲手弄出来过血流成河的场景。
一个古教的人，全被他杀光了！
那是他之前一直待着的古教。

待了整整六年。
自他出生后，他就被江叔送到了这个古教。
他杀光古教的人，倒不是古教的人对他不好。
相反。
古教的人对他非常好。
他无论做什么，古教都会顺着他。
他要什么，古教也会满足他。
而他杀光古教的人。
原因无它。
仅仅只是因为他在古教内待着太过无聊了。
他为了寻求刺激。
一刀割掉了一位女弟子的脑袋。
当时，女弟子脑袋被他割掉，鲜血喷了他一身。
他兴奋坏了。
总算是找到了一件刺激好玩的事情！
他自此一发不可收拾。
杀光了这个古教内的所有人。
古教内的人当时反抗了。
但根本没用。
content_en:
The sky and earth were dark, and violent storms raged across the land.
The terrifying thunder was like a ferocious centipede, roaring in the dark sky, as if announcing the arrival of death.
The power of the Emperor of Heaven enveloped Dao Yi Holy Land.
With an irresistible momentum, it fell down!
"Ah... don't!"
"Uuuuuuuuah...I don't want to die!"
"Who's going to save us?"
Cries resounded throughout Daoyi Holy Land.
All the members of Daoyi Holy Land were crying in despair.
In the face of the power of the Emperor of Heaven.
They were too small, as small as dust, and completely powerless to resist.
"Ant."
High in the sky, the middle-aged man watched all this indifferently and laughed disdainfully.
"All the ants here are going to die!"
The boy was laughing too, without mercy.
He enjoys seeing rivers of blood.
Even——
He once personally created a scene where a river of blood flowed out.
All the people from the ancient religion were killed by him!
That was the ancient religion he had stayed in before.
Stayed for six full years.
Ever since he was born, he had been sent to this ancient religion by Uncle Jiang.
He killed all the people from the ancient sect, not that the people from the ancient sect were not good to him.
on the contrary.
The people of the ancient religion were very kind to him.
No matter what he does, the ancient religion will follow him.
Whatever he wants, the ancient religion will satisfy him.
And he killed all the people of the ancient religion.
There is no other reason.
Just because he was too bored staying in the ancient religion.
He's looking for excitement.
Cut off a female disciple's head with a knife.
At that time, the female disciple's head was cut off by him, and blood spurted all over him.
He was so excited.
Finally found something exciting and fun!
He has been out of control ever since.
Killed everyone in this ancient religion.
People within the ancient religion resisted at that time.
But it didn't work at all.
